description: Get one issue of the Algerian Journal Officiel by year and number: the links to its official editions and, when UpGrowth holds it, its summary (sommaire): the date and, section by section, the official titles of the texts published in the issue. The summary exists only for some years and issues; otherwise data.sommaire is null and data.note says why. For 1962 to 2001 the summary is read from the scanned issue: data.sommaire.source says so, data.sommaire.titles_held_back counts the entries the readings did not agree on (not listed) and data.sommaire.complete is true when none is missing. For Morocco (country MA) pass the number of the Bulletin officiel, a continuous series (for example 7522): you get its publication date, the links to its French and Arabic editions and, in data.supplements, the supplements of that number (bis, ter); data.sommaire is always null, no Moroccan summary is held yet. For Tunisia (country TN) pass the number of the issue within the year (for example 97): you get its publication date and whether its French and Arabic editions exist, with no direct PDF link; data.sommaire is always null. Use it to find which texts an issue published. Without an API key only Algeria answers, for the current year and the two before it (older years return key_required).

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

number.description: Number of the issue. Algeria: its number within the year, starting at 1. Morocco: the number of the Bulletin officiel, a continuous series, for example 7522. Tunisia: its number within the year, for example 97. Find the numbers with list_jo_issues.

year.description: Year of the gazette: the Journal Officiel from 1962 for Algeria, the Bulletin officiel from 1912 for Morocco (country MA), the Journal Officiel de la République Tunisienne from 1956 for Tunisia (country TN). Find the years covered with list_jo_years. Without an API key only Algeria answers, for the current year and the two before it.

name: get_jo_issue
title: Get a Journal Officiel issue
